ARUNACHAT PRADESH
PUBTIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No. PSC-R(A)/02/2021, Dated ltanagar, the sth May'202L
ADVERTISEMENT
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission invites applications through online from
the citizens of India for filling up 1 (one) post of Medical Physicist (Group-A) under the Department
of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh in the Pay Scale Level-10 Rs.56100-167300/-
of Pay Matrix) PM plus other allowances as admissible to A.P, Government Employees from time to
time. This post is reserved for Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe IAPSTJ Candidates only.
However, in case of non-availability of APST, the post will be treated as un-reserved as per
proposal/ requisition submitted. So Non-APST candidates may also apply for the post.
How to Apply :-
1. Before fitling up the 'Online Application' form for the post, applicants must mandatorily
register themselves with the Commission, through the facility of 'One Time Resis tration (OTR)'
available on the Commission's Website www.appsc.goY'in
2. Detailed instructions, for 'One Time Registration (OTR)' and for filling up the 'Online
Application', are available on the above mentioned website. Applicants are advised to submit only
one application. If an applicant submits more than one application, the Commission will take
cognizance of only the applications with higher RlD. Fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted
against any other RID.
3. Applicants, with existing registration on OTR, need not register again and can directly log in
to filI up the Application Form using their user lD and password'
4. Elieibility:
(a) The Applicants must possess a M.Sc. Physics with Post M.Sc. Diploma in
Radiological/Medical Physics from a recognized University/Institution or M.Sc in
Radiological Medical Physics to equivalent from a recognized /Institution desirable.
(b) Internship of Minimum 12 [twelve) months in a recognized well equipped Radio Therapy
Department, at the time of actual interview, they shall have to produce proof of successful
completion of the compulsory internship certificate'
